name: notes
description: Front 116 — an application's manifest. `bpp` is the whole configuration of the file kind, an object (decision 338): `default` names the ONE dependency whose `pub default fn` — a template function, jhonstart's `html` (decisions 198, 200) — this project's `.bpp` files unfold onto; `style` (here absent: no file has a style section) would name the dependency whose `pub default fn` a `--- style ---` section unfolds onto. For each file the toolchain copies the header — from the first line to the separator line — into the module as written and hands everything after the separator `---` to that function as its literal; it knows no tag and no library. A `.bpp` file is listed in `files` like any module.
